items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Tommy Stevenson only in response to the interviewer's prompt ('Gil, Buck and Tommy') and discusses the Douglas Brothers' style and history, but does not describe a personal interaction or professional collaboration with Tommy himself.

ctx.x: So anyway, as I said, Tuskegee is really a ROTC department and so we had this uniform and all, and now me being in the electrical department, I'm supposed to know, which I did, we had a special place where you had to

have the proper wattage for you to press. For you to iron anything, you got no business ironing anything in your room, so we were getting ready to make up a parade or something and I'm going to be all sharp in uniform, and I was in the room pressing, and we had a guy, we all called him the biggest snitch, he was the captain's stoolie in ROTC and he looked like he could slip--
